name: Prusa Nextruder
description: Direct drive extruder system used in Prusa MK3.9, MK4, MK4S, XL, and CORE One printers. Features a 10:1 planetary gearbox for high torque in a compact form factor, with a large no-slip drive gear for reliable filament feeding including flexible materials. The Nextruder integrates its own PCB with a dedicated CPU and stepper driver, and includes a load cell sensor for nozzle-based bed probing.

motorSpecs.motorType: Pancake stepper with integrated planetary gearbox
